images.edition: Brieven aan Johan de Witt, Japikse ed., Deel 1
images.content: Van Beuningen circle letter, 19/29 Sep 1657 (a copy not in Van Beuningen's own hand); footnote states the same letter also survives as a separate unsolved cipher copy, in another hand

note: The printed edition text on this page is the plain copy; the cipher copy 'van een andere hand' is not printed and not imaged this pass -- its archive location (NA 3.01.17, De Witt's own archive, or elsewhere) was not resolved this pass.
